headline: RBI Absorbs ₹9,388 Crore in Overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India accepted ₹9,388 crore in offers against a notified amount of ₹50,000 crore at a cut-off and weighted average rate of 5.49% in its 1-day VRRR auction.
why: The Reserve Bank of India conducts reverse repo auctions to manage surplus banking liquidity and align short-term money market rates with monetary policy objectives.

impacts.name: India Overnight Interbank Rate
impacts.why: RBI liquidity absorption via VRRR directly impacts overnight rupee money-market rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
